Security Note: At this stage, the MCP server is intended for local use only.
If using the StreamableHTTP transport, always configure the MCPALLOWEDORIGINS environment variable to restrict access to trusted origins only.
Security Note: Depending on the query, the MCP server may expose certain Terraform data to the MCP client and LLM.
Do not use the MCP server with untrusted MCP clients or LLMs.
